exec: pm.test('Toutes les instances attendues sont UP', () => {

const direct = pm.response.json(); pm.sendRequest(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{gateway}}/service-pret/loans'), (err, res) => { pm.test('Gateway identique', () => { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(res.json()).to.deep.equal(direct); }); });
